purpose: Use the runtime agent's multimodal main model only as a bounded visual-candidate fallback outside active choice intake when trusted structured facts, current-match user confirmation, and scoped HUD or owned-augment OCR are insufficient.

model_policy.reason: The host CLI agent that understands strategy should inspect the frame with live_state and catalog context, then return structured facts. This keeps visual interpretation aligned with the current match plan instead of splitting perception into a detached OCR/VLM/API service.
model_policy.source_label: vision_model remains the technical source label for visual observations, but product/runtime UI should treat it as multimodal_agent_sensing.

fallback_use_cases: left inventory/item bench understanding after an explicit equipment refresh or conflict check
unit-attached equipment on trusted self-board anchors after an explicit equipment refresh or conflict check
non-choice special trait or effect text explicitly requested by the user
not_responsible_for: augment, active-season, or item/anvil choice candidate intake
own board and bench unit identity when MuMu 4352/4353 is available
shop identity when MuMu 4354 is available
phase status when MuMu 4358 is available
final user selections without user confirmation or match history
opponent board unit identity, opponent positioning, and lobby power scanning

storage_policy.production_frame_lifecycle: capture frame -> host CLI agent native multimodal inspection -> structured JSON -> delete frame
storage_policy.debug_fixture_exception: Only explicit calibration fixtures may keep image files.

runtime_policy.cruise_policy: Cruise must not start vision automatically. A bounded visual candidate request is allowed only after an explicit equipment refresh/conflict request or an explicit non-choice special-text request.

mode_policy.augment_choice: Current-match user report only. Do not start OCR or host multimodal sensing for candidate names.
mode_policy.descriptor_owned_season_choice: Any active-season choice declared by the compiled descriptor uses current-match user reports only. Do not start OCR or host multimodal sensing for candidate names.
mode_policy.item_choice: Current-match user report only. Do not start OCR or host multimodal sensing for candidate names.
mode_policy.refresh_self_state: MuMu structured sources own board, bench, shop, inventory, and trusted equipped-item facts. Resident HUD ROI OCR owns phase.stage_round, hp, gold, level, and XP. Multimodal sensing may only supply unresolved diagnostic candidates.

candidate_database_context.icon_asset_role: reference/candidate database for the multimodal main agent, not a live template-matching product path
candidate_database_context.vision_reference_pack_role: mode-scoped icon/name candidate pack passed alongside the current frame so the multimodal agent can visually pair visible equipment, augments, and champion icons without relying on OCR ROI or local matcher scores
candidate_database_context.vision_reference_pack_policy: The pack is not an observation and not a matcher result. It may include all current-season items/augments for hard visual modes plus live-state champion anchors. The model returns structured candidates with possible_ids when icons are shared or ambiguous.
candidate_database_context.matching_policy: The model should pair visible UI with candidate names/IDs from these databases. It should prefer exact visual/text matches, keep possible_ids for ambiguity, and use live_state/strategy context only as tie-break evidence.

input_context.prompt_rule: The model should identify only visible facts. It may use MuMu unit anchors and catalog names as constraints, but must not invent unobserved equipment, augments, or selections.

output_contract.host_cli_agent_response: Codex CLI or Kimi Code CLI writes JSON matching expected_response_shape; no separate model API service is required.
output_contract.host_cli_agent_response_writer_policy: Host visual response backfill must be written through Node UTF-8 no-BOM atomic JSON writer, not PowerShell Set-Content.
pollution_guards: Never write own board_units or bench_units from vision model output.
Self modes write under visual candidates only and do not override verified MuMu bridge fields.
Unknown or catalog-unmatched names stay unresolved candidates.
Same-icon/same-name ambiguities keep possible_ids instead of forced unique IDs.
Do not create opponent board/unit/positioning live_state facts from visual output.

fallback_policy.rapidocr_worker: resident product fast path for owned-augment text and HUD phase/economy fields; active choice candidate OCR is compatibility/calibration only
fallback_policy.icon_matcher: scene-scoped fallback or conflict validation only. It never overrides MuMu structured facts or confirmed selections.

product_decisions.no_opponent_board_vision_path: Host multimodal vision is not a product path for opponent board/unit/positioning advice. It may inspect user-provided screenshots only as ordinary chat context, not as live_state mutation.
